title: Prohibition on supplying practitioners with pharmacy-referencing blank forms
rule_summary: A licensee may not provide any practitioner with blank prescription forms which refer to any pharmacist or pharmacy. The violation is complete on providing the form: no payment, no agreement and no patient actually steered is required.
exam_relevance: Tests a prohibition whose trigger is the pre-printed reference itself rather than any exchange of value, which distinguishes it from the referral-remuneration prohibition.

authority.name: Massachusetts Board of Registration in Pharmacy regulations

common_confusions: Looking for remuneration or an agreement before finding a violation
Requiring proof that a patient was actually steered
Assuming supplying the forms free of charge cures it
verification_notes: Read verbatim in the current official publication on 2026-08-20 during Batch 3 tranche B3-C authoring under Issue #91. A fresh independent legal and full-bank realism audit is still required before release.
